messages:
anna-ptl: Quick sweep — can we lock owners and due dates for RCA-592 action items? I pulled the list from the doc and flagged gaps.
miguel: I can own the datastore migration task (item 1). Targeting 2024-06-12 for rollout to canary. Will there be a freeze window?
ops-lead: Miguel — yeah, plan for canary 06/12, full rollout 06/18. Please add the canary checklist to the PR.
samir: I’ll take item 3 (query timeout tuning) but need a dependency on eng-runtime to land the KV-cache fix. ETA 06/14 if eng-runtime unblocks.
jess: Assigning item 5 (alerting thresholds + runbook) to me. Will draft thresholds by EOD tomorrow and link runbook to the incident doc. :memo: 
anna-ptl: @sre-bot remind: ensure postmortem doc gets updated with owners + dates after this thread.
sre-bot: Reminder created: "RCA-592 owners update" due 2024-06-05. Assigned to anna-ptl.
miguel: FYI I opened PR #3147 for migration infra. Added checklist snippet:
```
- smoke tests pass
- canary deploy to us-west-2
- fallback to v1 model variant
```
ops-lead: Good. Add the rollback command in PR: `infra/deploy --rollback=3147`.
samir: Pinged eng-runtime in #eng-runtime — @leila said she’ll try to get the KV patch merged by tomorrow morning. If that slips, can we postpone my tuning to 06/16?
jess: That's fine, just update the doc with new due date. I’ll coordinate alerts once Samir confirms final thresholds.
anna-ptl: Summary for doc: Miguel -> datastore migration (06/12 canary, 06/18 rollout). Samir -> query tuning (06/14 or 06/16 depending on KV patch). Jess -> alerts/runbook (draft by 2024-06-06). Ops -> approve canary checklist in PR. SRE-bot -> reminder for doc update.
miguel: double-checking dependencies: Samir needs KV patch, Ops needs infra quota signed off by finance. Ops, can you confirm quota by 06/09?
ops-lead: Confirmed — I'll escalate to finance today and aim to have signed by 06/09. :white_check_mark:
samir: Thanks. If KV patch lands, I’ll run canary tuning tests 06/13 and post logs to the incident doc.
anna-ptl: Great. Can everyone update the incident doc with explicit owner and ISO8601 due date by EOD tomorrow? I’ll do a final pass Friday morning then close the loop with PMs.
jess: Will update runbook link once draft is up.
miguel: Added owners + dates to doc just now. PR link in the thread.
sre-bot: Deploy bot: canary started for PR #3147 at 2024-06-12T10:15:00Z. Status: in-progress.
anna-ptl: Thanks all — if you hit blockers, reply here. Otherwise I'll run closure sweep next week. :wave:
